title: Serve desktop renderer files
responsibility: Serve files beneath the renderer root with a content policy and fallback to the app entry page.

inputs.name: rendererPolicy.html
inputs.description: HTML whose inline scripts are hashed for the script policy.

inputs.name: rendererPolicy.connect
inputs.description: Additional trusted connection-policy text; defaults to empty.

inputs.name: rendererAssets.connect
inputs.description: Additional trusted connection-policy text; defaults to empty.

outputs.name: rendererPolicy
outputs.description: Content policy allowing local assets and the HTML inline-script hashes, with restricted frames, objects and base URLs.

outputs.name: rendererAssets
outputs.description: Response with file bytes, media type, content policy and no-sniff header; missing files fall back to index.html, while rejected routes or escaped paths receive a refusal response.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Malformed URLs or escapes and filesystem/read failures can reject the operation.
